pillars.title: Cost
pillars.body: A large roster at almost no per-athlete capital cost — shared fields, shared staff, and posts as the only fixed item. Facilities cost can be zero.

pillars.title: Barriers to entry
pillars.body: Rugby uses existing fields like football, soccer, or lacrosse, minimal equipment, and welcomes all shapes and sizes.

pillars.title: Demand
pillars.body: Thousands of players compete at the club level nationally with no varsity option, and a fast-growing youth and high-school pipeline feeds the college game every year.

pillars.title: Support
pillars.body: Backed by USA Rugby and World Rugby, with governance, standards, insurance, and a defined competition structure.
